answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Email domain with SPF DKIM and DMARC passing. It requires a domain with all three mail checks green, so the juniper of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. A farm's usual trick is reuse, and this kills reuse outright: a domain with all three mail checks green is fresh per account, and the nebula is that yesterday's proof is worthless today. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the zephyr is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
